name: ARTH 3991
title: Field Studies Internship in Art History
description: Supervised practical experience in museum and museum related work.   Section one: Wadsworth Atheneum Internship. Participation in  Museum Studies Seminars, staff meetings and completion of individual  project at the Atheneum. Application must be approved by  Wadsworth Atheneum Education Department; deadlines are in April  for first semester and in November for second semester. May be  repeated for credit. May be repeated for a total of 12 credits.
requirement_description: Two 1000 level ARTH courses; two 3000-4000 level ARTH courses; open to sophomores or higher.
